tools.name: check_page_seo
tools.description: Checks one public web page the way search engines see it: HTTP status, robots.txt and meta robots rules for Googlebot, Bingbot and AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot), canonical, sitemap presence, title, meta description, headings and sharing tags. Use it when someone asks

tools.name: find_keyword_ideas
tools.description: Returns real searches people type into Google around a topic, from Google autocomplete, grouped into questions, comparisons, buying searches and others. Use it for keyword research, blog post ideas, finding what a business could rank for on Google, or seeing how customers phrase a need. No search vo

tools.name: generate_llms_txt
tools.description: Reads a website's homepage, navigation and sitemap, then writes an llms.txt file (the markdown summary some AI tools read) that the owner can upload to the site root. Use it when someone wants their site understood or cited by ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity. Returns the file content.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Lists the websites in the user's AI SEO Crew account with their status (plan being built, ready), article counts, where the crew publishes, and the account plan status. Start here to get site IDs for the other tools.

tools.name: add_site
tools.description: Adds a website to the user's AI SEO Crew account and starts building its SEO plan: the crew reads the site, works out what the business sells and plans articles from real Google searches. Use it when someone wants SEO done for their website, wants blog posts that bring traffic from Google, or wants

tools.name: get_seo_plan
tools.description: Returns the SEO plan of one site: progress while the crew is still building it, then the planned articles in writing order with their target Google search, monthly search volume and intent, plus the article IDs used by write_article and skip_article.

tools.name: add_topic
tools.description: Adds a Google search the user wants to rank for to the top of a site's SEO plan, with an optional article title. The crew writes it next.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: Lists a site's articles by status: written (waiting for approval), in_progress, published, or failed. Published articles include their URL and Search Console clicks and impressions when connected. Paginated.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Returns one article: title, status, meta description, target search, the full text in Markdown, its sources and, once published, its URL.

tools.name: write_article
tools.description: Asks the crew to research and write one SEO blog post from the site's plan right away, sourced and in the site's own style, instead of waiting for its slot. Use it when someone wants a blog article written for their website to rank on Google. Counts toward the plan's monthly articles. Needs an activ

tools.name: publish_article
tools.description: Publishes one written article to the user's live website through its connected platform (WordPress, Webflow, Wix, Framer, Shopify, GitHub or webhook), then resubmits the sitemap. Only for articles with status written. Visible to the public once done: confirm with the user first.

tools.name: skip_article
tools.description: Removes a planned, failed or written (unpublished) article from a site's plan so the crew never writes or publishes it. Cannot be undone. Published articles stay on the website.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Returns Google Search Console results for a site over the last 28 days: total clicks and impressions, and the published articles with the most clicks. Use it when someone asks how their SEO or blog traffic is doing. Needs Search Console connected in the app.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_page_seo, find_keyword_ideas, list_articles, get_article, write_article · Private data: generate_llms_txt · Public sink: find_keyword_ideas, generate_llms_txt, write_article, publish_article.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_page_seo, find_keyword_ideas, list_articles, get_article, write_article · Private data: generate_llms_txt · Public sink: find_keyword_ideas, generate_llms_txt, write_article, publish_article

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
